# watchpoint_regions (Data Source)

The public catalog of monitoring regions available to authenticated users.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All available monitoring regions. Use the IDs in a location profile.
data "watchpoint_regions" "all" {}

output "active_region_ids" {
  value = [for r in data.watchpoint_regions.all.regions : r.id if r.is_active]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `regions` (Attributes List) All active, public regions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `city` (String) City.
- `country` (String) Country.
- `country_code` (String) ISO country code.
- `display_name` (String) Friendly display name.
- `healthy_node_count` (Number) Healthy, active probe nodes.
- `id` (String) Region ID.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the region is active.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether the region is publicly listed.
- `latitude` (Number) Latitude.
- `longitude` (Number) Longitude.
- `name` (String) Region name.
- `probe_node_count` (Number) Total probe nodes in the region.
- `provider` (String) Cloud provider.
- `provider_region` (String) Provider-native region identifier.
- `slug` (String) Region slug.
- `sort_order` (Number) Display sort order.
- `tier` (String) Region tier (e.g. `Standard`, `Premium`, `Enterprise`).
